title: Image standard opens form a basis after graded scalar extension
statement: Let R,S,A,B be commutative rings with the stated algebra structures, let 𝒜 and ℬ be graded submodules, let β : S ⊗_R A ≃ₐ[S] B and ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ satisfy β(1 ⊗ a)=ψ(a), and suppose every ℬ_n is the S-span of ψ(𝒜_n), with the irrelevant ideal of ℬ mapping into that of 𝒜. Then the opens basicOpen ℬ (ψ f), indexed by positive homogeneous f in 𝒜, form a topological basis of Proj ℬ.

source.place: Tag 01N2, standard-open covering argument from homogeneous spanning

proof.text: Use the positive homogeneous standard-open basis on Proj B. For a homogeneous b in ℬ_n, write b as a finite S-linear combination of images ψ(f_i) with f_i in 𝒜_n. In the domain of a homogeneous prime, b not in the prime implies at least one ψ(f_i) is not in it, so each standard neighborhood refines by an image standard open. The irrelevant-ideal hypothesis ensures the resulting opens cover Proj B.
